quarterly_data.signal: Three months ended June 30, 2026: net sales JPY 24,465 million (-39.1%), operating loss JPY 1,961 million (prior-year operating profit JPY 5,792 million). Industrial Equipment segment sales JPY 4,976 million against JPY 14,455 million and segment profit JPY 221 million against JPY 7,183 million; Industrial Equipment sales in China were JPY 196 million against JPY 8,119 million. The Medical Equipment Business was transferred at the beginning of the fiscal year and is no longer a reporting segment.
